# Food & Pixels

> > A New York City dining blog featuring restaurant reviews, omakase experiences, and Michelin-starred establishments across Manhattan, Brooklyn, and beyond.

Food & Pixels chronicles fine dining and casual restaurant experiences primarily in NYC, with a focus on Japanese cuisine, omakase, and seasonal tasting menus. The site covers Michelin-starred restaurants, Restaurant Week specials, and neighborhood dining gems from Harlem to Williamsburg.

## Key Topics

- NYC dining
- Michelin-starred restaurants
- Omakase experiences
- Japanese cuisine
- Fine dining
- Restaurant reviews
- Upper West Side
- Sushi restaurants
- Restaurant Week
- New York restaurants
- Chef's Table experiences
- Brooklyn dining
- Tribeca restaurants
- West Village dining
- Harlem restaurants

## Featured Reviews

- [Food & Pixels](https://www.foodnpixels.com): Homepage featuring Sushi W omakase review on NYC's Upper West Side
- [Michelin 2020 New York Stars](https://www.foodnpixels.com/michelin-2020-new-york-stars): 2020 Michelin Guide coverage featuring NYC starred restaurants

## Japanese & Omakase

- [Sushi W](https://www.foodnpixels.com/sushi-w-new-joint-on-the-west-side): Review of Sushi W omakase on Upper West Side Broadway
- [Kosaka](https://www.foodnpixels.com/kosaka): Chef Kousaka's West Village omakase sushi restaurant review
- [Tempura Matsui](https://www.foodnpixels.com/tempura-matsui): Chef Matsui's fine dining tempura omakase in New York
- [Momosan](https://www.foodnpixels.com/momosan): Momosan ramen and sake bar review by Morimoto in NYC

## Fine Dining & Michelin Stars

- [The Clocktower](https://www.foodnpixels.com/the-clocktower): Michelin-starred Clocktower at Edition Hotel in MetLife Tower
- [little park](https://www.foodnpixels.com/little-park): Andrew Carmellin's vegetable-focused Little Park in Tribeca

## Restaurant Week & Special Series

- [THE DAVID BURKE EMPIRE in restaurant week part 2](https://www.foodnpixels.com/the-david-burke-empire-in-restaurant-week-part-2): David Burke's Fishtail seafood restaurant during Restaurant Week
- [THE DAVID BURKE EMPIRE in restaurant week part 3](https://www.foodnpixels.com/the-david-burke-empire-in-restaurant-week-part-3): David Burke Kitchen farm-to-table review in Soho during Restaurant Week

## Neighborhood Gems & International Cuisine

- [Fandi Mata](https://www.foodnpixels.com/we-found-mediterranean-in-williamsburg): Fandi Mata Mediterranean restaurant review in Williamsburg, Brooklyn
- [The Cecil Harlem](https://www.foodnpixels.com/the-cecil-harlem): The Cecil Afro-Asian brunch review in Harlem
- [Her Name is Han](https://www.foodnpixels.com/her-name-is-han): Han Korean restaurant review featuring bulgogi in NYC Koreatown
- [Yuca (Delicious Miami pt III)](https://www.foodnpixels.com/yuca-delicious-miami-pt-iii): YUCA nuevo latino Cuban fusion on Miami Beach's Lincoln Road
